title: Replace any() in a verify with an ArgumentCaptor
summary: A test that only checks a mail was sent learns to check who it went to.

turns.user: SignupServiceTest only checks that send got called. the recipient could be garbage and it still passes

assistant.body: Great catch. any(Mail.class) matches whatever is passed, so right now the test only proves the call happened. An ArgumentCaptor grabs the Mail that was actually passed, and AssertJ checks its recipient and subject. In other words, verify answers whether it was called, and the captor answers with what.

turns.user: oh wait, with an invite code the inviter gets a mail too. so 2 mails. test that as well

assistant.body: Note: getValue only returns the last call, so with two mails use getAllValues to get both. times(2) on the verify makes sure it was sent exactly twice. Use containsExactly if the order matters and containsExactlyInAnyOrder if it does not.
